text: The unit test test_mean in test_stats.py fails. Find the bug in stats.py and fix it with a one-line edit. Do not change test_stats.py. Then run `python3 -m unittest test_stats -v` in the project directory and report whether all tests pass.

blocks.text: All tests pass. The bug was in `stats.py` line 6: the mean function was dividing by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`. This is an off-by-one error that would give incorrect results for the arithmetic mean. The fix changes it to divide by `len(values)`.
